name: typescript-on-rails
description: An agent-native full-stack TypeScript framework with an architecture compiler and modular official runtimes.
author: Sam Millunchick

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bin.js', 0o755);"
scripts.emit: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noCheck && node --input-type=module -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bin.js', 0o755);"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/reference-saas/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:packages: npm run packages:build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:fullstack-loader
scripts.test: npm run emit && npm run test:core && npm --prefix examples/reference-saas run test:app && npm run test:packages
scripts.reference:check: npm --prefix examples/reference-saas run check && npm --prefix examples/reference-fullstack run check
scripts.packages:runtime-build: npm run build --workspace=@typescript-on-rails/fullstack && npm run build --workspace=@typescript-on-rails/web && npm run build --workspace=@typescript-on-rails/postgres && npm run build --workspace=@typescript-on-rails/jobs && npm run build --workspace=@typescript-on-rails/testing
scripts.packages:build: npm run packages:runtime-build && npm run build --workspace=typescript-on-rails-reference-fullstack
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run template:check && npm run emit && npm run architecture:check && npm run reference:check && npm run packages:check
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
